message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover with a black background and red borders on the left and bottom. At the top, the large white word "TEMPO" is centered above the line "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Further up, two smaller text lines read "ALIRAN SUAP BENUR EDHY PRABOWO" and "BERPACU MENEKAN SUBSIDI ELPIJI".

The central graphic is a yellow circle containing several elements. Two hands emerge from the center: a left hand in a white sleeve holding a black revolver, and a right hand in a white sleeve and grey cuff with its fingers shaped into a gun. Below these hands, two red SUV-style cars are positioned facing inward. The words "POLISI · versus ·" are arched along the top of the circle, while "FPI" is centered at the bottom.

Beneath the circle, white text reads: "Kesaksian polisi dan Front Pembela Islam soal penembakan enam pengawal Rizieq Syihab, bertolak belakang. Siapa yang berbohong?". At the bottom left, there is a QR code, a barcode with "9 770126 427302", and vertical text including "14-20 DESEMBER 2020".
